purpose: For every package: CONSULTANT_FINDINGS -> CONFIRMED/CONTESTED/UNSUPPORTED -> NEW_UNKNOWN -> BELIEF_CHANGE -> NEW_NEXT_ACTION -> PACKAGE_REVISION_REQUIRED. This is the first time the AI demonstrates learning from external challenge.

evidence_status_taxonomy.CONFIRMED: Consultant finding verified against independent source
evidence_status_taxonomy.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Consultant finding partially verified; some aspects require correction
evidence_status_taxonomy.CONTESTED: Consultant finding contradicted by independent evidence
evidence_status_taxonomy.UNSUPPORTED: Consultant finding has no supporting evidence
evidence_status_taxonomy.CONSULTANT_ESTIMATE: Consultant's own estimate, not independently verified
evidence_status_taxonomy.UNKNOWN: Cannot be verified without further evidence
